cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've assigned you the restaurant call. Cancel my anniversary table; the number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Questions are deferred. You may take this one task off me before we discuss anything else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. What if they offer another date?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may refuse it for me. Then sit here while I put the glasses away. I authorize a full account of your day; I don't have words for mine.

reason: A directs both practical help and permitted conversation while revealing need without explaining the event; use my anniversary to avoid implying B necessarily shares it.
